the cinchona alkaloids, in addition to their well-known ability to catalyze the asymmetric addition of a nucleophile to an aldehyde or imine, can also catalyze the enantioselective addition of a nucleophilic carbanion to an aldehyde, thus providing an alternative to the widely used Evans-Tishchenko reaction.
